parameters.code: var scene=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/MainScene.unity",UnityEditor.SceneManagement.OpenSceneMode.Single); var go=UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("Door"); if(go==null) go=UnityEngine.GameObject.CreatePrimitive(UnityEngine.PrimitiveType.Cube); go.name="Door"; go.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(3,1.5f,4); go.transform.localScale=new UnityEngine.Vector3(1.5f,3,0.3f); UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene); UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene); UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AllowAutoRefresh(); UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.Refresh(); var roots=scene.GetRootGameObjects(); return System.Array.ConvertAll(roots,p=>new {name=p.name,position=p.transform.position.ToString("F2"),missing=UnityEditor.GameObjectUtility.GetMonoBehavioursWithMissingScriptCount(p)});
